viewers.title: Higgsfield inventory — used vs unused
viewers.blurb: Every clip of the Higgsfield pull (101 classes, 720 clips) sorted into six tiers by how the project uses it: on the 152-row grid as seen/unseen (13 classes) or zero-shot (10), trained as S0 but off-grid (13), in the corpus but dropped (3), curated with sidedness but never processed (10 classes, 105 clips), raw only (52 classes, 354 clips). Per clip: corpus / S0-trained / test-band / grid-endpoint / grid-reference badges, contact-sheet thumbnail, hover to play, cdn provenance. The material for growing the seen/unseen and same-source zero-shot tiers of the eval grid. Regen: scripts/viewers/build_higgsfield_inventory.py (+ `thumbs`).

viewers.title: EffectData — 3,061 effects + counterfactual axes

Browse every class at preview res with search + category facets; a second page shows the two CTT counterfactual axes — same operator × different endpoints, and same endpoints × different operator (shared source-id verified identical first frame, 0.99/255). Media served straight from the external staging dir via a symlink; nothing copied into the repo.
viewers.notes: Preview set = one clip/class (3,061, 845 MB) + annotations.json, staged at $LAB/data_external/EffectData (outside repo, re-downloadable from HF, ~822 GB full). Data JSONs built by scripts/viewers/effectdata_pipeline/{build_index,build_counterfactual,remote_zip}.py; remote_zip.py pulls single clips out of the per-effect zips via HTTP range (no full download). Counterfactual galleries = 137 clips in cf_media/. Assessed for CTT as an external S4/S5-style breadth stratum, not a cttv2 replacement.

viewers.title: SEGUE supplementary — picker (internal, all candidate arms)
viewers.blurb: Internal, unblinded picker over the SEGUE supplementary. For every row in the four owner collections — teg_user_study (24), vfx_transfer_user_study (26), supplementary_teg (54), supplementary_vfx_transfer (224) — it shows ALL candidate generations that were open when the row was saved (3,746 candidate clips = 3,446 own + 300 prior-work; seeds 42/43) and lets the owner pick the best 'ours' clip per row. Plays the ORIGINAL store/outputs/eval_ladder clips directly (no transcode), lazy-loaded on scroll. Prior-work clips (categories external/teg) are greyed and non-pickable. Picks persist to eval_ladder/viewer/collections/supplementary_picks.json through the static server's POST endpoint (X-Base-Updated optimistic concurrency, 409-merge, localStorage mirror), served as picks.json next to the page; supplementary/build_site.py --picks wires them into the public site (C/D SEGUE clip; A/B only with --apply-comparison-picks). Rebuild: supplementary/picker/build_picker.py [--check].
